name: Student financial aid and education loans
one_line: The protected financial-aid lifecycle: applications and eligibility summaries, school aid offers, verification and disbursement records, and education-loan documents. It uses the Finance schema while keeping schools, issuers, servicers, aid periods, tax years, admissions packets, and repayment groups in their distinct roles.

proposed_fields.why_no_existing_key_works: Aid records repeatedly identify an aid, award, or academic funding period such as 2026-27. tax_year is the source year for tax information and can differ from the period being funded; application_cycle is scoped to College Applications and does not describe later disbursement or servicing records; term is scoped to Academic and may cover only part of an annual award. Reusing any of them would collapse different time roles. This is a proposal for R1c, not a legal Finance fact yet.
proposed_fields.note: If R1c finds the same need in insurance, benefits, subscriptions, or grants, it should consider a broader shared period key rather than mint several near-synonyms. Until adjudicated, aid-period text remains evidence and a P9 grouping anchor; it is not used in dimension_order.

deterministic: a processed aid-summary structure with an explicit aid or award period, a labelled eligibility section, a student or contributor block, and labelled aid categories or eligibility results. A program name alone does not fire; the labelled structure does

a school-issued financial-aid offer with an issuer in the letterhead and separate labelled sections for cost of attendance or net cost, grants or scholarships, work-study, and loans. The combination distinguishes an aid offer from a tuition bill and from an admissions decision

a labelled aid-disbursement or student-account-credit structure: a school or aid administrator in the issuer position, a named aid program, a scheduled or posted disbursement, and a student-account or enrolment-period reference

a financial-aid verification request or worksheet issued by a school aid office that identifies the aid process, the requested evidence, and the relevant aid period. The attached tax, identity, or academic records retain their own domains; the request does not copy their facts

an education-loan origination structure with a labelled borrower block, a student-loan program or education-purpose statement, a promissory or loan-agreement heading, and repayment terms. The education-purpose evidence is required because a generic loan agreement belongs to finance.loans-mortgage

an education-loan servicing statement with a labelled servicer, loan or account slot, payment due information, and principal or interest breakdown, plus an education-loan program or school-certification reference. Without the education evidence it is only the general loan situation

an email whose labelled sender resolves to an aid office, aid administrator, or loan servicer and whose labelled subject names an aid offer, verification action, disbursement, or student-loan account event. Email source_type alone never fires

an archive manifest that lists an aid-summary or aid-offer anchor beside verification forms, loan documents, or disbursement records, inspected without unpacking. The manifest can support a candidate packet; it never writes member facts onto the archive or archive facts onto members
needs_llm: an OCR-derived portal capture that must be distinguished among an admissions portal, a financial-aid dashboard, a bursar account, and a student-loan servicer
an unlabelled special-circumstances or aid-appeal letter whose prose explains a change in family finances but never names its document role

an award-shaped letter that could be a scholarship application outcome, a school aid offer, a study-abroad grant, or a standalone certificate; the model must cite the direction and function of the document and may return unknown

a heterogeneous verification or aid-application packet whose tax, identity, academic, and finance members are content-incoherent but may share one submission purpose. The result is reviewable group membership, not propagated facts
a servicing-transfer or repayment-plan letter whose prose names several organizations and does not label which one is the current servicer
a multilingual or non-domestic aid record whose program and document-role vocabulary is absent from the injected jurisdiction catalogue
a sparse file named Award Notice.pdf or scan_0048.pdf that may join a strongly anchored aid-period neighborhood but carries too little evidence to receive institution, account_type, or record_type
never_alone: the words aid, award, grant, scholarship, bursary, loan, or work-study alone. They occur in application prompts, course readings, resumes, marketing material, tax documents, and news articles
a school, government agency, lender, or servicer name alone. A school can be an issuer, a prospective destination, the holder's school, or merely one entry in a comparison list
an amount, currency symbol, contribution index, account balance, or percentage alone. These values are sensitive content and do not establish a domain or a legal field
an aid-period or academic-year string alone, and especially not as tax_year. A period funded and the tax year used to assess eligibility are different roles
a bare 4-digit number. It may be a year, school code, form number, account tail, postal code, or identifier

a list of schools on a common aid summary or common financial-aid application. The listed schools are recipients or comparison candidates, not automatically the record issuer, school fact, or target_university fact

an application upload or recipient list as proof that every member has a College Applications purpose. A tax return or transcript submitted for aid keeps its own facts and receives no target from packet membership
a source_type or extension alone. A PDF is not an aid offer, a spreadsheet is not an offer comparison, an email is not a disbursement notice, and a ZIP is not a verification packet
membership in one folder or download session. It can retrieve candidate neighbors but cannot prove topic, purpose, institution, or aid period
a loan number or servicer name alone. It can be a general personal loan, mortgage, vehicle loan, or education loan and needs a labelled education-loan context
missing EXIF as proof that a portal image is a screenshot. Screenshot evidence and aid-domain evidence are separate questions, and conflicting signals require abstention

a tax return, identity scan, transcript, or pay statement inside a verification archive as proof that the member itself is a student-aid record. The archive manifest supports a packet; each member activates schemas from its own evidence

work_types: grant, scholarship, or bursary award notice
secure portal export or aid-data summary
grouping_reasons: one aid period at one school across its offer, verification requests, adjustment decisions, disbursement notices, and student-account credits. Until aid_year is adjudicated, the period is a grouping anchor rather than a written Finance fact

one common aid application across its submission acknowledgement, processed eligibility summary, corrections, and requests for further documentation. Several listed schools do not make several issuer facts

one education-loan lifecycle across the promissory note, counseling records, school disbursement, servicing statements, repayment changes, and payment confirmations. A repayment-centered branch may also belong to the finance.loans-mortgage situation

one special-circumstances or aid-appeal case across the request, supporting documents, correspondence, and decision. Supporting tax, identity, medical, legal, or employment records retain their own facts
one file re-downloaded or corrected: duplicate_family and version_family are universal facts and do not become aid fields

one record in more than one accepted group: an aid offer can support a college decision, a mobility grant can support a study-abroad term, and a loan statement can support both an aid history and a repayment history. Membership never copies facts

template.why: A shallow institution then record_type recommendation preserves the issuing role and keeps an intelligible document leaf without forcing every mixed aid offer into one of its several grant, work-study, and loan line items. account_type is deliberately optional: it helps when a corpus has distinct institutional-aid and education-loan series, but on a combined offer it can be multi-valued and would split one record. tax_year is excluded because an eligibility source year is not the period funded. The proposed aid_year would be the natural middle dimension, but it is not legal until the shared field catalogue accepts it, so this row does not smuggle it into the order. A common application summary that lists several schools should stay under its actual issuer or remain flat; listed recipients do not become issuer branches. The user may reverse, remove, or flatten the recommendation, and an accepted aid-period packet may remain whole.

collides_with.signal: Both situations can see the same education debt and the same school and servicer names. Aid applications, eligibility summaries, school offers, and disbursement records are supported by an aid period and school-aid process; a repayment account is supported by principal, interest, payment, and servicer structure. A student-loan statement can support both accepted groups on separate evidence, but the school name or servicer name alone must count for neither. Reciprocal fixture: Student Loan Statement Jun 2026.pdf.

An aid or award word beside an institution and an amount appears on scholarship applications, award outcomes, aid summaries, offers, and tuition records. Applicant-side submission or outcome structure belongs to the scholarship situation; account, eligibility, school-offer, or disbursement structure belongs here. A word, organization, or amount alone decides neither. Current aid-summary fixture: 2026-27 FAFSA Submission Summary.pdf; the reciprocal node uses its historical Student Aid Report filename.

Aid forms, profile acknowledgements, portal captures, and offer comparisons travel with an admissions packet. The application side needs a unique admissions addressee and cycle or a packet-purpose anchor; this side needs a financial-aid application, eligibility, offer, account, or disbursement structure. A released-to school list is not a set of target facts. Reciprocal fixture: CSS Profile Acknowledgment 2026-27.pdf.

Tuition-assistance applications, deposit records, and school offers carry the school name and entry period in the same high-weight zones as admission records. Household-finance declarations, assessed contribution, amount-due, payment-schedule, or aid-account structure support this side; admission, entry-grade, guardian-signature, and enrolment-decision structure support the K-12 application side. A school name or entry year alone decides neither.

A mobility-grant letter combines home institution, host or program, study period, amount, payment schedule, and account instructions. The money and disbursement structure supports this side; enrolment, course, and credit structure supports study abroad. The institution-plus-program pair alone must not count for both. Reciprocal fixture: Erasmus Grant Award Letter.pdf.

A financial-aid award letter and an academic credential can share school letterhead, an office signature, a person name, and an annual period. Aid amounts, eligibility, or disbursement structure support this side; registrar attestation, grades, credits, or a conferred credential support the academic-record side. School letterhead alone decides neither. Reciprocal fixture: Financial Aid Offer - Harbour University - 2026-27.pdf.

An education-savings plan can be both a custodial investment account and a source of school funding. A labelled holdings table under a plan-account descriptor supports the investment situation; a beneficiary-student slot together with school-payment, aid, or disbursement structure supports this situation. The education purpose alone decides neither. Reciprocal fixture: 529 Plan Statement Fall 2026.pdf.

sensitivity_why: Aid applications and verification packets can expose student and contributor identity, tax, income, assets, household circumstances, immigration or dependency evidence, signatures, school choices, and loan balances. Finance is a safety domain, so classification and protection precede any model or automated placement path. Raw values, complete text, OCR, filenames, and combined packet dossiers stay local; any allowed model review must use a bounded, redacted dossier under user policy. This row assigns no handling class: D2 leaves the authoritative classification to P7.
open_question: Two connected decisions remain. First, should aid_year become a canonical destination-eligible field, or should R1c fold it into a broader shared benefit or coverage period used by other record templates? The current fields cannot represent the funded period without misusing tax_year, application_cycle, or term, so this node keeps the period as evidence and a group anchor. Second, the roster hint includes loan servicing while finance.loans-mortgage already claims the repayment-account lifecycle. This node treats education-purpose and aid-history evidence as one possible group and repayment structure as another, with overlapping P9 membership allowed; Joseph or R1c must decide whether P10 should routinely surface both templates for the same student-loan series or choose one branch posture.
